What a room allows a job to spend was set, or set back to the default.

**Direction:** Chips → the log  
**Sent by:** Chips only; refused from a client  
**Requires a run:** no  
**Schema:** [`space.spend_ceiling_set.json`](/schema/space.spend_ceiling_set.json)
